Specialization.Name: Quartermaster (reSpecialized) 1.12
Specialization.Description: [H4]Quartermaster (reSpecialized)[h4] [B]QUARTERMASTER—PITHY DESCRIPTION[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The Quartermaster is the person in charge of armaments, requisitions, and general preparedness for any military operation. They are both the gateway to and gatekeeper for any tools of rebellion.[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] ½ General Negotiation & Making Credits ¼ Supplies and Material-Based Utility ¼ Narrative Forward Debuffing[BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Procurement of material for the waging of war[BR Managing resources in a military unit[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Negotiation not relating to supply[BR] Computers, but not slicing.[BR] Being detail-oriented[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Entrepreneur[i](second-closest match after the Trader. They share a shrewd logistics sense for making money do work, but the focus of the QM is to put the money to greatest effect, not having money make more money)[BR] [I]Analyst[i](Their overlap is specifically in their attention to detail and how that effects their allies. The QM has even less of a computers focus than the Analyst).[BR] [I]Trader[i](Probably the closest of the trees. It’s about the stuff, not the money. Especially with how the characters can dip into the underhandness).[BR] [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] RADAR (M*A*S*H)[BR] Red (Shawshank Redemption)[BR] Steve Cortez (Mass Effect)[BR] [I]updated 12/11/2025[i]
